tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild anemia (low hemoglobin, low MCV, low iron), likely microcytic, with low total protein and mildly decreased CO₂. NT-proBNP is elevated, suggesting possible cardiac dysfunction or heart failure. HbA1c is above target, indicating suboptimal glycemic control. Renal and liver function, electrolytes, and cardiac troponin are within normal limits. Recommend further evaluation of anemia and cardiac status.
